text:
tara_sales: Hey all — SentinelAI (trialing "sentinel-xxl") wants a short preflight for model onboarding. Primary asks: do we support function-calling + streaming with their model, what the POC timeline looks like, and a ballpark cost for ~250k tokens/day.

sam: Quick checklist from eng: 1) Is the model causal decoder-only? 2) Are there any custom attention or MoE layers? 3) Do they plan to use embeddings or just generation/function-calls? 4) sample prompt sizes + max seq.

tara_sales: They said causal, no MoE, function-calls enabled, avg prompt 120 tokens, max 4096, concurrency target 50. Sent an S3 link with a container + hf bundle.

mike_eng: Good. Main compatibility points: KV-cache persistence for large seqs (4096) — we'll need to verify tokenization and cache layout. Streaming + function-calling usually OK but we need a health endpoint if it's a container. Quantization: if they ship fp16 we can recommend q4_0 or q8_0 depending on layer norms; that will materially change latency.

nina_sec: Security side: they're enterprise, require SOC2 attestation + proof of data deletion within 30 days. They also asked about SAML SSO and customer-managed KMS for Private installs. I'll need completed questionnaire + data-flow diagram.

charlie_ops: Ops note: 50 concurrent users @ 4096 seq will push GPU mem. Rough Dedicated sizing: 6x A10G-equivalent if fp16, 3-4x if q4 and CPU offload for tokenizer. Hosted POC is fine for initial eval but won't meet strict SLA. Estimate for 250k tokens/day: Hosted POC $15k-$30k/mo, Dedicated starting reserved $18k+/mo with lower per-token. (will refine after perf sweep).

tara_sales: Can we give them a short "run this and send back JSON" compatibility probe? Something minimal they can run in container or python.

mike_eng: I'll craft two options: one for container, one for HF bundle. Container probe (they run inside container):

```bash
# inside container (assumes python3 available)
python - <<'PY'
import requests, json
r = requests.post('http://localhost:8080/probe', json={'test_prompts':["hello world","function call test"], 'max_seq':4096})
print(json.dumps(r.json()))
PY
```

mike_eng: For HF tarball they can run:

```bash
python -c "from redwood_probe import run; print(run('path/to/model'))"
```

mike_eng: We will run the same probe and check keys: tokenization_ok, kv_compat, supports_streaming, suggested_quant. If tokenization_ok==false or kv_compat==false we escalate.

infra-bot: task created #4782: run sentinel-xxl compatibility scan when artifacts uploaded (assignee: mike_eng).

nina_sec: Also request: list of third-party libs and their licenses, any telemetry back to vendor, and where training/inference data is stored. This feeds the KMS + retention answer.

charlie_ops: FYI enterprise blocker we often hit: if they demand dedicated HSM-backed keys for every tenant, that requires Private with HSM integration and ~8-10 week lead time. Call that out now.

tara_sales: I'll capture that in the POC scoping doc. Sam — can you add a short note about nonstandard layers? If they actually have MoE or custom CUDA kernels, timeline jumps.

sam: Yep. If custom CUDA ops present we need build-and-validate cycles; estimate +4-6 weeks.

tara_sales: Pricing options to propose in POC: 1) Hosted trial — no infra commit, faster (2-4 weeks), higher per-token; 2) Short Dedicated trial — reserved nodes for 4-6 weeks, lower per-token but requires commit. Charlie — can you provide 2-line cost bullets for the email?

charlie_ops: Sent via DM: Hosted ~ $0.06-$0.10 / 1k tokens -> est $15k-$25k/mo for 250k tokens/day. Dedicated -> $0.015-$0.04 / 1k tokens + reserved nodes ($18k+/mo). SLA: Dedicated 99.9% with on-call, Hosted best-effort.

nina_sec: I'll upload the security questionnaire to the shared folder and prefill answers where possible. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sentinel-qa. Please ask Sentinel to return it within 48 hours to keep POC on schedule.

mike_eng: One more: we need to confirm whether they expect prefix caching across sessions (shared KV) or per-session only; that impacts cache design and privacy.

tara_sales: I'll ask them to clarify on the questionnaire. Also asking if they want metrics exported to their Datadog account or keep internal only.

sam: Reminder — include an evaluation prompt set (5-10 prompts) for quality/regression checks during the perf sweep. Preferably some long-context ones to stress 4096.

tara_sales: I'll ask for those. OK folks — action items: mike_eng: probe script + run plan; nina_sec: questionnaire link + prefilled answers; charlie_ops: refine cost bands for two POC paths; sam: list of ops that increase lead time. I'll draft outbound email once I have these and ping the customer.

mike_eng: Will post probe gist + expected output by EOD.

nina_sec: Uploaded QA doc and redacted sample DFD template.

charlie_ops: I'll schedule a perf-sweep slot next week pending artifact upload.

tara_sales: Thanks team :rocket: Closing thread after kickoff or if we hit blockers.
